fb_text:
"My guys won't use another app."

Good. This isn't one.

There's nothing to install. Nothing to log into. No forms, no training, no dashboard your crew ignores by Thursday.

Your guys text like they already do. FieldNotes turns those texts into service logs, answers their questions on the spot ("what's the gate code at Riverside?"), and writes a clean recap your client can see after the visit.

Your crew never touches an app. You get the whole picture anyway.

And the "sounds expensive" part: the whole team is $79/month. One avoided client dispute pays for a year.

Try it free for 30 days — no credit card: fieldnotesapp.io/app/try.html
